articles.title: U.S. warns shipping firms they could face sanctions over paying Iranian tolls in Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: The US warned shipping firms they could face sanctions for paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. This could include digital assets or in-kind payments for safe passage, affecting about a fifth of the world's oil and natural gas trade.

articles.title: Trump administration argues Iran war effectively ‘terminated’ before 60-day deadline for
articles.summary: The Trump administration argued that the US war with Iran was effectively terminated before a 60-day congressional approval deadline. This stance was taken to circumvent the requirement for congressional approval.

articles.title: Iran executes two for spying for Israel
articles.summary: Iran executed two individuals, Karimpour and Bakarzadeh, for spying on behalf of Israel. They were accused of passing sensitive information to Mossad and collecting details on government and religious figures.

articles.title: US warns shipping firms they could face sanctions over paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: The US warned shipping firms of potential sanctions for paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. Payments could be made in digital assets or through informal swaps for safe passage through the strategic waterway.

articles.summary: China urged the reversal of the UNIFIL departure from Lebanon amid escalating conflict. The UNIFIL mission has faced growing casualties as Israel and Hezbollah continue to fight, prompting concerns over regional stability.

articles.title: Spirit Airlines says it’s going out of business after 34 years and is ending operations
articles.summary: Spirit Airlines faces shutdown as government bailout time runs out. The airline is in bankruptcy proceedings for the second time in two years, struggling with soaring jet fuel prices due to the Iran war.

articles.title: US embassy warns citizens in UK as threat level raised to ‘severe’
articles.summary: The US embassy in the UK has raised its threat level to 'severe' and advised citizens to avoid schools, churches, and tourist locations, also varying their travel routes. The embassy did not specify the nature of the threat.

articles.title: U.S. to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany in next 6-12 months
articles.summary: The US will withdraw about 5,000 troops from Germany over the next 6-12 months, fulfilling President Donald Trump's threat. The withdrawal is part of a broader dispute between the US and Germany over the US war with Iran.
